<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>node not found</span></div>

## Why it happens

The node ID or browse path is wrong, or the namespace index differs from the one on the server.

## Fix it

Browse the server with an OPC UA client and copy the node ID exactly, including `ns=`.

## Check that it worked

The key's value appears on the device.
